name: WHM Inquiry Button for WooCommerce
author: WhmDesign

sections.description:
Product Inquiry Button for WooCommerce lets your customers send product inquiries and quote requests directly from any WooCommerce product page. Perfect for B2B stores, custom/made-to-order products, wholesale shops, or any store where customers need to ask questions before buying.

Core Features

  • Inquiry button on any WooCommerce product page
  • Customizable button text, color, and position
  • Beautiful modal popup form — no page reload
  • Configurable form fields: Name, Email, Phone, Quantity, Message
  • Admin email notifications for every new inquiry
  • Customer confirmation email on submission
  • Full inquiry management dashboard — view, respond, delete
  • Filter and bulk-manage inquiries by status (Pending, Responded, Converted, Closed)
  • Works with Simple, Variable, and Grouped products
  • Option to hide Add to Cart button and replace with inquiry button
  • Show inquiry button on category and shop archive pages
  • Translation ready (POT file included)

Pro Features

Upgrade to Product Inquiry Button Pro to unlock:

  • Quote Cart — multi-product quote lists with one consolidated submission
  • WhatsApp Button — branded WhatsApp button with dynamic message templates
  • Convert to Order — turn accepted quotes into live WooCommerce orders instantly
  • Price Hiding — hide prices per-product or globally, show custom text instead
  • PDF Quotes — branded PDF quote documents attached to response emails
  • Follow-up Automation — auto-email customers who haven’t been responded to
  • reCAPTCHA v3 — invisible spam protection, zero friction for real users
  • Advanced Analytics — conversion rates, revenue estimates, response time KPIs
  • Per-Product Routing — route notifications to different emails per product
  • Webhooks & Zapier — fire webhooks on any event, connect to any automation
  • SLA Tracking — get alerted when an inquiry hasn’t been answered in time
  • Multilingual — full WPML & Polylang support

Who Is This For?

  • B2B and wholesale stores
  • Custom / made-to-order product shops
  • Furniture, machinery, industrial equipment stores
  • Any WooCommerce store that needs a “Request a Quote” workflow

Privacy & External Services

This plugin does not send any data to external services in the free version. All inquiry data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services in the free version. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

If you enable reCAPTCHA v3 (Pro feature), the plugin will connect to Google’s reCAPTCHA service to verify form submissions. In that case:
* Data sent: The user’s reCAPTCHA token and your site’s secret key.
* When: On every inquiry form submission when reCAPTCHA is enabled.
* Service provider: Google LLC
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Product Inquiry > Settings to configure the button text, colors, and form fields.
  4. The inquiry button will automatically appear on your WooCommerce product pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work with all WooCommerce product types?

Yes. The plugin supports Simple, Variable, Grouped, and External/Affiliate products. You can enable or disable each type individually in the settings.

Can I customize the form fields?

Yes. You can toggle Name, Email, Phone, Quantity, and Message fields on or off, mark them as required, and rename their labels in Settings > Form & Fields.

Where do I see the submitted inquiries?

All inquiries appear under Product Inquiry > Inquiries in your WordPress admin. You can filter by status, view details, reply to customers, and delete entries.

Can I hide the Add to Cart button?

Yes. Go to Settings > General > Display Options and enable “Hide Add to Cart Button”.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully internationalized and ready for translation via standard WordPress translation methods.

Where can I get Pro features?

Visit wpcod.online to purchase the Pro license.
